name: loom-npm-pinned-fixture
description: Tiny fixture package for the npm-pinned capability's real-spawn smoke test (card e7d6e43b) — installed via a real `npm install --ignore-scripts` from a LOCAL tarball, never the real npm registry. No dependencies. Carries a postinstall script ON PURPOSE (card e7d6e43b, Code Review Minor) so the real-spawn test can prove --ignore-scripts actually suppresses it, with a positive control (a plain npm install of the SAME tarball) proving the script is genuinely capable of running.
